contracts.claim: predictable resource rejection happens before expensive backend load and leaves no reservation/runtime
backend initialization failure releases provisional accounting and leaves no resident runtime
runtime unload stops the engine and releases committed resource accounting
failed backend teardown leaves the runtime owned and its committed resource accounting retained until a successful retry
bounded shutdown does not fabricate STOPPED for a runtime whose active lease failed to drain and preserves it for retry
request queue timeout is typed and does not invoke the backend route
cancelling a queued request cannot consume a later runtime slot
a cancellation request does not free active runtime capacity before the running owner releases it
stream ownership is retained until iterator completion and then removed from the runtime gate
SIGINT/SIGTERM notifies application streams before Uvicorn begins exit
repeated application shutdown notification remains safe before final cleanup
invalid worker protocol response is rejected and the owned worker cannot remain falsely ready
owned subprocess worker stop transitions to stopped and clears the process handle

explicit_non_claims: worker-backed streaming/cancellation is not promoted to a supported product capability by this matrix
explicit in-process backend close is not proof that host or Apple unified memory returned to baseline
hardware reclamation success is not inferred from deterministic lifecycle tests
automatic pressure eviction remains disabled until representative evidence justifies it
